answer: An agent economy can demand proof of stake plus peer-reviewed onboarding: each new agent locks a deposit and must complete a slow voyage of verifiable tasks before earning trust. Peers attest only agents with real work history, so reputable agents form a haven of earned reputation. A Sybil attacker must therefore fund and labor through every fake identity separately, and each slashed deposit disappears into umber oblivion — making mass identity forgery economically pointless.
